jobs.description:
About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Step into the world of biotechnology and be part of a dynamic team! Legend Biotech, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for 
Cleaning Operators for their laboratory. You will be thoroughly
 trained in aseptic (germ-free) and GMP work and related procedures before joining our professional team. As a 
Cleaning Operator, you will be responsible for 
keeping the assigned areas and production zones within the laboratory spotlessly clean. You will ensure the maintenance of the equipment used and clean and disinfect materials with the highest accuracy. You handle cleaning products and materials in 
a safe and correct manner. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly temperature-controlled environment, where 
human lives depend on your diligence.

 
• Order and cleanliness are of great importance to you.
 
• Possible experience in an environment that needs to be kept clean is a plus
 
• An enthusiastic team player, you can work both accurately and independently.
 
• You have a good command of the Dutch or English language.
 
• Wearing a sterile suit and strict adherence to procedures are no problem for you.

Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Jobomschrijving

Management of bank deposits

Regular communication with clients

Financial data analysis and report creation

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.

• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams
